# Built-in actions for Android, loaded by the program on Android (the app packages this file; it is
# copied to the app's folder on every start, so do not edit that copy). Bind one with "alt+q = @name"
# in any config, or define an action of the same name in your own config to override it.
#
# Android cannot inject keys without root, so an action here runs one of the system's global actions
# through the accessibility service. Each one is sent as a key that stands for it (see
# src/platform/android/android_input.h): browserback = Back, browserhome = Home, apps = Recents,
# launchmail = Notifications, browserrefresh = Quick settings, scrolllock = Power menu,
# pause = Lock screen, printscreen = Screenshot. A mapping that sends any other key is not applied:
# the original key goes through unchanged.
#
# [action name]
# description: what it does
# category: group name in the GUI (optional)
# step, step        (each step is a key or combo; steps run in order)

# --- System ---

[action back]
description: Go back
category: System
browserback

[action home]
description: Go to the home screen
category: System
browserhome

[action recents]
description: Open the recent apps
category: System
apps

[action notifications]
description: Open the notification shade
category: System
launchmail

[action quick-settings]
description: Open the quick settings
category: System
browserrefresh

[action power-menu]
description: Open the power menu
category: System
scrolllock

[action lock-screen]
description: Lock the screen
category: System
pause

[action screenshot]
description: Take a screenshot
category: System
printscreen
